item.title: The UFO Disclosure Movement: Is Humanity Ready for the Truth? (Ad-Free)
item.description:
Mark Dorian is the founder and publisher of the Great Awakening Report (GAR), an independent research and media platform dedicated to exploring human consciousness, UFO disclosure, emerging technologies, and the global transformation of society. With more than four decades of experience in research, investigation, entrepreneurship, and business development, Mark has dedicated himself to examining the ideas and developments that could reshape humanity's understanding of reality. Under his leadership, the Great Awakening Report has grown into an extensive collection of more than 1,000 research reports, 250 podcasts and interviews, educational programs, and independent investigations.

Beyond his work with the Great Awakening Report, Mark leads Global Transitional Research & Consulting, where he helps entrepreneurs, organizations, and business leaders navigate periods of significant change. His research explores the intersection of consciousness, human potential, disclosure, and emerging global developments, raising important questions about what humanity may be preparing to discover. Through his investigations and interviews, Mark encourages audiences to look beyond conventional narratives, examine available evidence, and consider how new information about our world could influence the future of human civilization.

Spaced Out Radio is your nightly source for alternative information, starting at 9pm Pacific, 12am Eastern.  We broadcast LIVE every night.
